assessment: A project-owned fd-based chmod of exactly project and control from 0775 to 0755 is technically compatible with the current UID 1000 staging writer and removes the group-write bit that v4 correctly rejects. POSIX access/default ACL xattrs are absent (ENODATA=61), so no observed ACL dependency. Other group-1000 users would lose creation/rename rights in these two directories; the readback cannot prove no such workflow exists. No chmod to shared source, OUT, staging, tmp or child files is needed.

preconditions: Confirm this dedicated Nanhai project root/control are not intentionally shared write interfaces for another active UID; if they are, use a new exclusive project path and revised peer-reviewed binding, not a weakened gate.

Before mutation, repeat strict-host-key readback and require exact path, UID/EUID 1000, GID 1000, dev/inode values from this receipt, directory/no symlink, mode 0775, no POSIX ACL access/default, and absent v4 lease and v7 final.
Use an independently reviewed, single-use project-only correction command and durable local intent/terminal receipts; no staging or graph in the same command.
narrow_one_shot_correction.action: SSH to gz02 with fixed /usr/bin/python3.12. Walk path components by dirfd/O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW; re-fstat both held directory fds; fchmod control fd to 0755, then project fd to 0755; fsync each and re-fstat/read back exact dev/inode/UID/GID/mode and no ACL. No recursive chmod, chown, unlink or source path change.
postconditions: Fresh independent read-only SSH check of project/control path, inode, ownership, 0755, ACL absence, lease/final absence.
Rerun v4 fresh read-only preflight; only if PASS consider a separately released one-shot --stage. No graph authorization follows.
narrow_one_shot_correction.rollback: If correction fails before any v4 lease/final exists, restore 0775 only through same identity-checked held fds, read back and record terminal; if identity or state is uncertain, stop for read-only reconciliation. After staging, do not automatically restore group write: that would reopen the parent replacement boundary. Any later restoration needs separate safety review and must not coexist with trusted staged runner.

limitations: getfacl executable is absent remotely; direct getxattr checks found no POSIX ACL data on either directory.
No proof of all possible group-1000 consumers or active process expectations; owner approval of mode policy remains a dependency.
Existing child dirs out/staging/tmp remain 0775 and are outside this narrow fix; they require their own later graph safety review.
